title: I audited this store in 60 seconds
caption: Most stores don't need more traffic. They need fewer leaks. 3 leaks, 3 fixes, plus the prompt to audit your own store. Save it. #shopify #ecommerce #ecommercetips #aitools

beats.headline: This store has *traffic.*
beats.say: This store gets *traffic*, but almost no *sales.* Let me audit it live.

beats.headline: Audit in *60 seconds*
beats.say: Sixty seconds, three leaks, and the exact *prompt* to audit your own store.
beats.box: the exact prompt to audit your own store.

beats.headline: It's a *leaky* bucket.
beats.say: [sigh] More ads won't fix a *leaky* bucket.

beats.headline: The last one's the *worst.*
beats.say: Three leaks. The last one's the *worst.*
One. The headline says, elevate your lifestyle. *What* do they sell? It says *nothing.* Fix it: say what it is and who it's for, in under eight words.
Two. Shipping only shows up at *checkout.* Surprise fees are one of the biggest reasons carts get abandoned. Fix it: *show* shipping on the product page, or build it into the price.
Three. The mobile speed score is thirty-one. It takes *six* seconds to load, and most shoppers are on their phones. Fix it: *compress* your images and delete apps you don't use.

visual.prompt: Act as a first-time shopper. Here's my homepage. What's confusing, what's missing, and what would stop you buying?

beats.say: Now audit yours. *Paste* your homepage into any AI and tell it to act like a first-time shopper. Ask: what's confusing, what's missing, and what would stop you buying?
